description: This Java source file defines the QueryLiveCommandFactory class, a factory for creating immutable instances of various live command objects related to querying elements such as attributes, features, and things within the Eclipse Ditto signals framework. It provides static methods to instantiate specific command types based on given Command<?> objects.

classes.name: QueryLiveCommandFactory
classes.description: A final class providing static factory methods to create immutable instances of live query commands.
